snippet.title: Ranchonauts - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Ranchonauts on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5232990/Ranchonauts/?utm_source=youtube

Ranchonauts is a slapstick co-op game about herding alien sheep across a dangerous frontier. Work solo or with up to 5 friends to keep your flock together through physics-fueled disasters, pay off your ship-repair debt, and get home in one piece.

Come say hello on our Discord: https://discord.gg/goldfire
